articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA, the agency tasked with protecting America's cyber infrastructure, just leaked its own AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like a drunk sysadmin at 3 AM. Congress is rightfully losing its collective mind.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: A CISA contractor casually exposed highly privileged AWS GovCloud credentials and internal systems on public GitHub because apparently irony is the new security model. The foxes are literally doxxing themselves while guarding the henhouse.

articles.title: 23andMe inherits lawsuit over 'disturbing' DNA data breach
articles.summary: Critical RCE vulnerability in open-source Git service Gogs remains unfixed since March, with maintainers ghosting the researcher harder than your ex. Exploit module is live and the silence is deafening.

articles.title: ChatGPhish Vulnerability Turns ChatGPT Web Summaries Into a Phishing Surface
articles.summary: Palo Alto's GlobalProtect authentication bypass (CVE-2026-0257) is being actively exploited in the wild. When your enterprise firewall becomes a suggestion rather than protection, you know it's Tuesday.

articles.title: Microsoft threatens legal action against researcher Nightmare Eclipse for exploit disclosure
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens to unleash their 'Digital Crimes Unit' against security researchers disclosing zero-days, because apparently shooting the messenger is their new vulnerability management strategy. The infosec community is rightfully erupting.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification schemes are creating a surveillance hellscape where proving you're old enough to see a meme requires surrendering more data than the NSA wet dreams about. Privacy dies one birthday check at a time.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: License plate readers have evolved from catching speeders to stalking students and investigating noise complaints. Mission creep meets surveillance state, and your Toyota Corolla is now a person of interest.

articles.title: OpenAI Codex Authentication Tokens Stolen in codexui-android npm Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: 23andMe inherits a lawsuit over their 'disturbing' 2023 DNA data breach where they allegedly downplayed the mega-leak while paying ransoms. Your genetic privacy got sold cheaper than your cousin's MySpace data.

articles.title: What is hacking? Types, techniques, and how to protect yourself
articles.summary: CIA torture whistleblower John Kiriakou breaks down spy movies, probably explaining why real espionage involves more spreadsheets and fewer exploding pens. Truth remains stranger and more boring than fiction.

articles.title: Dutch Authorities Dismantle Botnet Linked to 17 Million Infected Devices
articles.summary: Critical WP Maps Pro flaw is being actively exploited to create rogue admin accounts on WordPress sites. Because apparently even embedding Google Maps can lead to total site compromise in 2025.
